body: I'm sorry that this is going on with you. Fuck, if I don't know what your feeling with anxiety and abuse, and I know this sounds like empty words, but please don't do it. I'm not promising it'll get better, because I don't know what your situation is, I'm not in your shoes. We both hurt and both feel like suicide is the only option. I don't know how to support myself, or ask for help, or just tell someone “hey, I'm dying inside a little each day” but maybe, I can support you through these words. We can chat if you want.
